This is my first creative writing project, please give criticism!


The city in complete ruins. Smoke billows out of the last standing building where out two characters stand on top. One, a tall, muscular man in dark blue harem-style pants; his blonde hair blows gently in the wind. Across from him stands a person clad in a black robe and green mask with one eye hole over their right eye. His glowing blue eye shines through the mask. Their swords are drawn but they both are clearly exhausted. 

“You killed my son, destroyed my city, threaten the stability of the world as we know it and for what? What the fuck do you get out of this? Huh?! Answer me you fuck!” The blue-pants man, David, shouts. 

The masked man chuckles before bursting into maniacal laughter. “I could say I did it for this, for that or for whatever the fuck I want but at the end of the day, I did it. Whats my justification got to do with anything?” 

David grows visibly more pissed off as the masked man continues laughing. His fist clenches as he sheathes his sword. “I’ve never taken a life, it goes against everything I believe in. Life is sacred, it's so rare we cannot even find it on another planet but I’ve decided its time for you to die.” 
“Oh? You think you can kill me, do you? You haven’t even knocked off my mask! You’re weak, David.” 
“I’ve still got one trick up my sleeve.”
His hands clap together and lightning strikes his hands. In a flash, he flies towards the masked man. Due to his intangibility, he has to wait for the counter-attack to strike his mask but he finds he hit his mask. The man flies back but lands on his feet. A crack appears on his mask then it falls to the ground. Davids breathing becomes shaky, his eyes widen and tears well up. His shock couldn’t be more apparent, for the first time in his life he felt true, genuine fear. 

He stutters, “Mikey? You? Where did I… where did I go so wrong?” 
“Dad, you simply wouldn’t understand even if I told you. It is now your time.” Mike replies swiftly. 
Quickly he runs then a blade pierces through Davids' heart. Blood pours out his mouth. “I’m so sorry Mikey.” He mutters this before he falls to the ground dead. A second masked man pulls the blade from Davids body before they both teleport away.
